name: Randall County, TX
findings: Randall County has 337 nonprofit organizations. 133 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Randall County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 18 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
